rulesPolicy: Source-backed ten-minute no-roll dressing for one whole extracted ordinary unit up to 1 lb. Measured gangue waste is explicit fixture content, retained mass is conserved, and no value/grade/condition/freshness change is inferred. General item-on-surface placement remains outside this fixture.

sources.scope: Mineral preparation: ten active minutes, compatible Miner's tools, two hands, stable accessible surface, one ordinary unit or predeclared portion up to 1 lb, and actual waste/retained mass recording.
Shared task setup, worker/tool history, feasible active work and retained claim/progress conventions.

dependencies: schema43 authored finite mineral unit and extraction receipt
shared WorkLedger reservation and active worker intervals
ordinary inventory ancestry and portable equipment custody
versioned snapshot codec, command receipts and replay
unsupported: predeclared portions and their physical identity
exceptional, oversized, damaged or incompatible material preparation
general production mineral content, residue reuse, refining or excavation
release approval and full engine coverage
